name: Charlotte Hope
biography: Charlotte Louise Norris, known professionally as Charlotte Hope, is an English actress. Born 1988, she is best known for her role as Myranda in Game of Thrones and her roles in Testament of Youth and The Theory of Everything. After appearing in Season 3 and Season 4 of the HBO series Game of Thrones, Hope reprised her role as Myranda for the final time in Season 5. She is the younger sister of musician Emily Norris.
